# Tac-Xpress Full System & Engineering Specification

> Comprehensive system documentation, architectural contracts, STEM mathematical formulas, and API surfaces for AI agents and automated reasoning engines.

---

## 1. System Architecture

Tac-Xpress is an enterprise logistics and cargo platform built with:
- **Framework**: Next.js App Router (React Server Components by default) on React 19.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with OKLCH CSS-first dynamic theme engine (`@theme inline`).
- **Database & ORM**: PostgreSQL via Supabase and Drizzle ORM.
- **Authentication**: Zero-cost, privacy-first Multi-Factor Authentication:
  - FIDO2 / WebAuthn Passkeys (Windows Hello, Touch ID, YubiKey) via `@simplewebauthn`.
  - RFC 6238 Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP Authenticator Apps) via `otpauth`.
- **Edge Interception**: Next.js `proxy.ts` architecture.
- **Monitoring**: Sentry error tracking with source maps.

---

## 2. Logistics STEM Mathematical Formulas

### 2.1 Cargo Dimensional Weight (Volumetric Conversion)
- **Express Air Cargo**:
  $$\text{Volumetric Weight (kg)} = \left\lceil \frac{\text{Length (cm)} \times \text{Width (cm)} \times \text{Height (cm)}}{5000} \right\rceil$$
- **Surface / Road Freight**:
  $$\text{Volumetric Weight (kg)} = \left\lceil \frac{\text{Length (cm)} \times \text{Width (cm)} \times \text{Height (cm)}}{4000} \right\rceil$$
- **Billable (Charged) Weight**:
  $$\text{Charged Weight} = \max(\text{Gross Weight (kg)}, \text{Volumetric Weight (kg)})$$

### 2.2 Commercial Pricing Sequence
1. Base Freight Charge: $B = \max(\text{Charged Weight} \times \text{Corridor Rate}, \text{Minimum Corridor Charge})$
2. Fuel Surcharge: $F = B \times \text{Fuel Surcharge Percentage}$
3. Terminal Docket & Handling: $H$
4. Subtotal: $S = B + F + H$
5. Goods & Services Tax (18% GTA rate): $\text{GST} = \text{round}(S \times 0.18, 2)$
6. Final Invoice: $T = S + \text{GST}$

### 2.3 Operational Hub Corridors
- `DEL`: Indira Gandhi International Airport Hub, New Delhi
- `GAU`: Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi Hub, Guwahati (Gateway to North-East)
- `IMF`: Bir Tikendrajit Hub, Imphal (Manipur)
- `CCU`: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Hub, Kolkata
- `BOM`: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Hub, Mumbai
- `BLR`: Kempegowda Hub, Bengaluru

### 2.4 SLA Breach Risk Scoring
$$R = \frac{\text{Elapsed Waypoint Duration}}{\text{Scheduled Leg Duration}} \times \text{Corridor Risk Factor}$$
- $R \ge 0.85$: Critical SLA alert triggered to operations dispatch.
- $0.70 \le R < 0.85$: Flagged as "At Risk" in queue telemetry.

### 2.5 Perceptual Color Science & APCA Contrast
- **Relative Luminance ($Y$)** in linear RGB:
  $$Y = 0.2126729 \, R_{\text{linear}} + 0.7151522 \, G_{\text{linear}} + 0.0721750 \, B_{\text{linear}}$$
- **APCA Contrast ($L^c$)**:
  $$L^c = \left( Y_{\text{txt}}^{0.57} - Y_{\text{bg}}^{0.56} \right) \times 100$$
- **Operational Contrast Thresholds**:
  - Status badges, pills, and chips: $|L^c| \ge 60$
  - Large display headings ($\ge 24\text{px}$): $|L^c| \ge 45$
  - Standard body text: $|L^c| \ge 75$
- **OKLCH Safe Chroma Array ($\mathbf{C}_{\text{safe}}$)**:
  $$\mathbf{C}_{\text{safe}} = [0.011, 0.032, 0.061, 0.091, 0.140, 0.147, 0.130, 0.107, 0.090, 0.073, 0.054]$$

## 3. Core API Surfaces & Data Contracts

### 3.1 Rate & Dimension Calculation
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/quote`
- **Request Body**:
  ```json
  {
    "origin": "DEL",
    "destination": "IMF",
    "mode": "air",
    "lengthCm": 60,
    "widthCm": 40,
    "heightCm": 35,
    "actualWeightKg": 12.5
  }
  ```
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "volumetricWeightKg": 17,
    "chargedWeightKg": 17,
    "baseCharge": 3400.00,
    "fuelSurcharge": 340.00,
    "handlingFee": 150.00,
    "subtotal": 3890.00,
    "gst": 700.20,
    "total": 4590.20,
    "currency": "INR",
    "estimatedTransitHours": 36
  }
  ```

### 3.2 Real-Time Shipment Telemetry
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/tracking/{awb}`
- **Parameters**: `awb` (Air Waybill tracking number, string)
- **Response**:
  ```json
  {
    "awb": "TAC-849204-DEL-IMF",
    "status": "in_transit",
    "currentHub": "GAU",
    "origin": "DEL",
    "destination": "IMF",
    "lastCheckpoint": "Guwahati Hub Inward Scan",
    "timestamp": "2026-10-03T04:15:00Z",
    "slaBreachRisk": 0.32,
    "eta": "2026-10-04T12:00:00Z"
  }
  ```

---

## 4. Agent Guidelines & Coding Standards

1. **ASD-STE100 Compliance**: Keep procedural sentences to $\le 20$ words. Use imperative mood and active voice.
2. **Library Discipline**: Use `@/components/ui/` (Shadcn UI) primitives. Never build custom duplicates when primitives exist.
3. **Color Tokens**: Never write raw HEX values in components. Use OKLCH tokens defined in `app/globals.css`.
